messages:
jordan: Quick sync — quarterly access review kickoff. I want to run a least-privilege scan across org accounts next Mon/Tue and do a focused admin-entitlement cleanup for KMS and service accounts. Thoughts?

maria: +1. Can we include audit-log retention verification? Last time some key rotation events were missing from the logs.

samir: Agree. For KMS, I can run a grants dump:

samir: ```bash
aws kms list-grants --key-id alias/redwood-prod --query 'Grants[].{GranteePrincipal:GranteePrincipal,Operations:Operations}'
```

samir: That shows which principals currently have decrypt/encrypt or retire/grant rights.

jordan: Nice. Also want a quick inventory of accounts with admin role across cloud orgs. Something like:

jordan: ```bash
# GCP
gcloud projects get-iam-policy redwood-prod --format=json > gcp-policy.json
# AWS (org roles)
aws iam list-roles --query 'Roles[?contains(RoleName, `Admin`)]'
```

maria: For audit logs, retention lives in the logging sink. I'll pull retention buckets and check if any sinks point to short-lived buckets.

access-bot: automated-scan: completed least-privilege baseline scan for redwood-prod at 2027-03-14T09:12:00Z. Findings: 12 service accounts with excessive permissions, 4 IAM groups with mixed admin/infra owners, 3 KMS keys with cross-account grants. See /drive/reports/lp-scan-2027-03-14.pdf

lee: Thanks. I'll open a PR to remove the legacy `org-admin-legacy` role from the infra group and propose swapping to `org-admin-lite` for ops. I'll tag infra and product owners. PR #4325.

jordan: Action items:
- samir: run grants dump for all prod keys and paste results to the thread by EOD today.
- maria: audit sinks + retention check — share list by EOD.
- lee: PR to demote legacy admin and add migration runbook (PR #4325).
- I'll schedule a 30-min review on Tue 10:00 PT to decide removals and emergency rollback plan.

maria: One thing — for service accounts used by batch jobs, we should add a short-term exception process rather than blanket removal. We can use a tag `lp-exempt` with expiry metadata.

samir: Good call. I'll annotate any SA I touch with `lp-exempt:2027-04-15` if we need to keep them.

lee: PR opened: https://git.company/infra/iam/merge_requests/4325. Diff removes org-admin-legacy from infra group and adds `org-admin-lite` with scoped perms. Please review.

jordan: I'll review PR before Tue's review. If folks can paste the outputs (grants dump + sink list) in this thread we'll be set.

access-bot: reminder: policy-change-window is Wed 02:00-05:00 UTC. Any removals flagged for immediate revocation outside that window will be queued.

maria: Uploaded retention audit: /drive/audits/log-retention-2027-03-14.csv — 2 buckets under 90 days, one is a temporary dev bucket. I'll file a short ticket to increase retention.

samir: Grants dumps pasted: /drive/ttl/grants-prod-2027-03-14.json — highlighted 2 cross-account principals that look like old CI bot accounts. I'll coordinate with CI team before removal.

jordan: Good work. We'll triage the 12 service accounts during Tue's meeting; if anyone sees an urgent break after changes ping #oncall immediately.

lee: Ack. I'll also add a section to the runbook for rollback commands (re-add grant via aws kms create-grant / gcloud iam policies).

maria: +1 on rollback steps. Also proposing we add an automated monthly least-privilege scan job and export to the security bucket.

jordan: Agree. Adding quarterly manual review + monthly auto-scan as new policy. I'll put the update in the compliance tracker.

samir: Done: added `lp-exempt` tags where needed and left notes on the SA descriptions.

lee: LGTM on PR from infra side. Waiting on product owner review.

maria: All artifacts uploaded. See you Tue 10:00 PT.

jordan: Thanks everyone. I'll post calendar invite and include PR + scan links. :thumbsup:
